edits.current: The document is the support of the payments or credits in account made to the employee in the month (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 arts. 2-3); it is not a periodic return. Where no payment or credit in account is made to an employee in the month (for example a full-month unpaid leave or suspension), no document is generated for that employee, and there is no nil document at employer level. Where payments exist but the deductions absorb them, a document IS generated with ComprobanteTotal 0.00 (see the zero-net-pay row).

edits.current: Fees of a non-executive director (honorarios de junta directiva) are not derived from an employment relationship, so they are outside the document, which supports only payments derived from an employment or statutory relationship and pensions borne by the employer (Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 2). They are paid and withheld outside payroll and reported by the payer in the third-party information return, as for an independent contractor (see the contractor row). A director who also holds an employment contract is reported for that contract only (see the executive-director row).

edits.current: A reimbursement of an expense the employee incurred on the employer's behalf, supported by the supplier's document, is not remuneration (CST art. 128: amounts received not for the employee's benefit but to carry out the job, such as transport, work tools and similar, are not salary) and is not an accrual of the employee; it is settled through accounts payable, not through this document. Per diems for meals and lodging ARE reported, in ViaticoManuAlojS (permanent, salary) or ViaticoManuAlojNS (accidental, non-salary) - NIE072 / NIE073.
